Historical full-card image of [[Concussion Missiles (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith) (Original)|Concussion Missiles]], matching the [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
